specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.9.0 rules remain active. This version adds four Output columns with the date and the time of pickup and dropoff in separate columns.

specification.description: v2.10.0 overlay: Pickup Time Only, Pickup Date Only, Dropoff Time Only and Dropoff Date Only (37 Output columns). Trip Date, Pickup Time and Dropoff Time do not change.

changes: DATE-TIME-SPLIT-001: new Output columns Pickup Time Only, Pickup Date Only, Dropoff Time Only and Dropoff Date Only, placed right after Dropoff Time (decision 2026-11-18).

Time Only columns use HH:mm, military time without seconds (07:25, 14:00); Date Only columns use MM/DD/YYYY (12/24/2026). Required format confirmed on 2026-11-18: TOBI rejected HH:mm:ss times with Pickup DateTime Invalid.
Dates come from the effective trip date, so a trip date change also updates them; times come from PUTime and DOAppt.
Dropoff Time Only and Dropoff Date Only are empty when DOAppt is empty, like Dropoff Time.
Trip Date, Pickup Time and Dropoff Time keep their format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.SSS. The Output now has 37 columns.
destination_columns_patch accepts a list of insertions.
Added acceptance tests AT-76 to AT-79.

split_columns.clock: military time (24-hour), HH:mm with leading zeros and no seconds

affected_destination_fields.Dropoff Date Only: effective trip date (MM/DD/YYYY); empty when DOAppt is empty

acceptance_tests_patch.case: PUTime 7:25, 07:25:00, 14:00, 12:00:30 or an Excel time fraction
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Pickup Time Only 07:25 or 14:00 (HH:mm, military time, no seconds)

acceptance_tests_patch.case: TripDate 12/24/2026, 2026-12-24 or an Excel serial date; trip date changed on screen
acceptance_tests_patch.expected: Pickup Date Only 12/24/2026; after a date change it shows the new date
Dropoff Time Only 09:00 and Dropoff Date Only 12/24/2026; both empty when DOAppt is empty
37 columns; the four new ones right after Dropoff Time; Trip Date, Pickup Time and Dropoff Time unchanged

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-79 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0 to v2.10.0
